strings.gwipeConfirm:
⚠️ Full Google wipe:

• Clears Play Store + Google Play services + Services Framework data.
• ⛔ You WILL be signed out of Google accounts (you must re-add them).
• Your photos and apps are untouched.
• The device reboots automatically after.

Are you sure?

strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart kiyibhokisi tora: inotarisa ikozvino kiyi bhokisi ichipikisana neGoogle's revocation list (CRL) uye inoedza kwakawanda kusvika yawana kiyi bhokisi rinoshanda, ine otomatiki backup uye kutanga patsva kwe Google masevhisi. Inomhanya papombi yega yega uye inoda internet (1-3 maminetsi).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox from network: downloads a keybox from the official repository (GitHub) and saves it to /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Needs internet and takes 1-3 minutes. Used when the smart fetch fails or when the keybox was changed manually.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP kuongororwa: inotarisa aripo Remote Key Provisioning modules, inoongorora TEE testestation certificate version, uye inoratidza KmInstallKeybox tool state. Hapana chinochinja - chimiro chakajeka chechigadzirwa.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine tarisa (kuverenga-chete): inoratidza Widevine mwero zviratidzo (L1/L3) kubva dumpsys, DRM (IDM) kiyi-faira kuvapo, uye zvinoenderana system zvivakwa. Hapana chinogadzirisa zvachose.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP gadzirisa: inomhanya sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. Inogadzirisa nyaya dzekupupurira kana otomatiki pass yatadza. Kumhanya kwese kunodhinda mutsara wakajeka wekubudirira/kutadza.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Full RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh full. Handles the hard cases and takes longer. A clear result appears at the end.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Reset GMS: inobvisa Play Store uye Google masevhisi (GMS+GSF) data uye reboots mudziyo zvoga. Nekusindimara kwehuchapupu chete - haimbobata mafoto ako kana mafaera.
strings.mdCertify: • Chitupa chekutamba: cheki RKP chitupa chinoratidza mamiriro emudziyo uye kuseta zvakare zvivakwa zvekupupurira kana zvichidikanwa. Haibate data yemushandisi.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER gadziriso: inogadzirisa Google masevhisi framework (SOTER) nyaya dzine chokuita nedevice attestation. Inoshandiswa kune mamwe maturusi anovimba neSOTER pachinzvimbo cheTamba Kutendeseka.
strings.mdPifApply: • Isa PIF: inomhanya sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh simba. Inoshandisa zvigunwe zvakasarudzwa (yemunharaunda/yepamusoro) uye inogadziridza iyo pif.prop/pif.json mafaera. Chigumisiro chakajeka chinowanikwa murogi.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF cheki: inoratidza yakaiswa injini mamiriro, zvigunwe mafaira (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), uye matanda. Tarisa chete - hapana chinogadzirisa.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary update: inoshandisa sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Inotora ichangoburwa Canary Injini kuburitswa kuti ive nechokwadi chekuenderana neinosungirwa RKP zvitupa (Kukadzi 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Engine diagnosis: checks the TrickyStoreOSS state (pid, logs), the keybox files (active vs user), the real vs spoofed device fingerprint, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP keys. Diagnostic display only.
strings.hintKbSlots: Iyo module inobata maviri kiyi bhokisi slots: yekutanga (inoyera, isina kumbopukutwa) uye yechipiri (backup). Iyi tebhu inoratidza kuti ndeipi slot iri kushanda, inoshandura zvaunofarira, kana kusimudzira yechipiri kusvika yekutanga pachikumbiro chakajeka - ine ma backups uye yakazara log.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Kuongororwa kwekuvimbika: tarisa TEE kiyi yekupinda, jekiseni reraibhurari mukati mekiyi chitoro2, mamiriro ekuregwa (CRL), kuvharirwa-rondedzero uye RKP nyika. Kuverenga-chete - hapana chinochinja.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Safe shandisa zvakare:

• Rondedzero yedziviriro inovakwa patsva kubva kune yega yega app yakaiswa.
• Iyo tsika-ROM inoenderana ne layer inoiswazve.
• The active keybox is re-apped.
• Google Play000#0000006masevhisi ari kudzimwa#00000chitangwazve#00000kutanga6 primary keybox is never touched.

Continue?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Keybox slots: inoratidza mamiriro ekutanga uye echipiri slots uye inochinja yaunofarira pakati pavo. Yepuraimari (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) inogaro chengetedzwa uye haimbopukuswi. Kusimudzira yechipiri kuenda kupuraimari kunoda simbiso yakajeka.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Simudzira chikamu chesekondari kuenda kupuraimari:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml inova iyo yekutanga slot content.
• Yezvino primary inochengetwa segadziriro yeparutivi isati yatsiviwa.
• Hapana chinodzimwa — the operation is reversible.

Endererai?
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Bvisa second slot:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml ichabviswa.
• The primary slot haina kubatwa.

Endererai?

strings.confirmKbSmart:
Smart keybox fetch (itsva muv3.17):

• Inotarisa bhokisi rekiyi razvino uchipikisa Google revocation list (CRL).
• Yedza kwakawanda kusvika bhokisi rakachena rawanikwa.
• Automatic backup + restarts#000006#5#50000#5. internet (1-3 min). Kuenderera mberi?
strings.confirmKbNet:
Tora kiyi bhokisi kubva paindaneti:

• Dhaunirodha bhokisi rekiyi repamutemo worisimbisa.
• Yakaiswa zvachose (haina kumbodzoswa pa boot).

⚠️ Inoda internet (kusvika 1 min). Kuenderera mberi?
strings.confirmRkpManual:
Re-provision RKP keys:

• Hapana data kana keybox mafaira anodzimwa.
• Reboot the phone afterwards.

Endererai?
strings.confirmRkpFull:
Kugadzirisa zvizere:

• Re-provisions RKP + restarts Google masevhisi.
• Chishandiso chinotangazve choga (hapana chinodzimwa).

Enderera mberi?
strings.confirmGmsReset:
Tangazve Google masevhisi:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — tangazve chete.
• Hapana chinodzimwa uye HAUCHABUDWA kunze.
• Chishandiso chinotangazve choga.

Enderera mberi?
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Manikidza kupazve (Red Magic):

• Pamidziyo isingatarisi bhokisi rekiyi radeuka.
• Inoshanda kunyangwe makiyi aine hutano.
• Hapana data inodzimwa.

Enderera mberi?
strings.confirmCertify:
Simba Play Store certification:

• Kudzima chete Store cache — account yako haina kubatika.
• Reboot, wozovhura Store.

Endererai?
strings.confirmSoter:
SOTER kugadzirisa:

• Inotangazve vendor.soter sevhisi.
• Inodzima SOTER server data chete.

Enderera mberi?
strings.confirmPifApply:
Isa zvigunwe (PIF):

• Shandura custom.pif.prop woiisa mugwara reinjini.
• Inoda reboot pashure.

Endererai?
strings.confirmCanary:
Gadziridza Canary fingerprint:

• Dhawunirodha ichangoburwa Canary fingerprint kubva Google.
• Syncs the security patch + restarts Google services (hapana pukuta).

⚠️ Inoda internet (1-3 min). Kuenderera mberi?
